description: `cli/transform-swc-factory-scope`'s test (a `jest.mock` factory that reads `window` and a module-scope variable not prefixed `mock`) with the preset's entry naming `babel-jest` instead, and no Babel config: babel-jest runs babel-preset-jest, whose babel-plugin-jest-hoist refuses the factory, so Jest 30.5.2 fails the file at transform with `The module factory of jest.mock() is not allowed to reference any out-of-scope variables.` and `Invalid variable access: window` (the file holds no TypeScript or JSX syntax, so Babel parses it as it is; `suffix` is `String('!')`, which the plugin does not hoist as a pure constant). Under `testEnvironment: 'node'`: the plugin allows every name on the global of the process that transforms, and Provino transforms in the worker, whose global a DOM environment has filled, so under jsdom Provino's babel-jest would allow `window` where Jest's refuses it. The kept lines leave out the `Allowed objects:` list (it follows the Node version) and the stack. Read by `provino`'s `transform-factory-scope.test.ts`. A black-box run.
